Subject: Exec approval request: Concordia combined credits + discount (RDW-3891)

Team — quick approval request for Concordia (deal RDW-3891). Summary below; attaching the customer's redlines where Legal flagged timing-related concerns.

Customer: Concordia Health (pilot)
ARR potential (estimate): ~$120k if pilot converts to production in Q1
Ask: 30-day trial extension (already provisioned) + $12,000 starter credit pool + 20% first-year discount on list pricing
Rationale:
- Delay due to SOC checklist; they want to continue integration without cost friction.
- High likelihood to convert to paid in Q1 (healthcare use case, strong product fit).
- Credits will be consumed primarily during integration testing (low token volume but critical to momentum).

Why I need signoff:
- Credits > $10k and discount > 15% both exceed AM self-approval thresholds; combination requires exec approval per Pricing policy.
- Legal has requested a clear start/end date for credits and an explicit rollback if adoption doesn't reach the pilot milestone.

Proposed terms (what I'll present to the customer if approved):
- 30-day extension (starts 2026-11-16)
- $12,000 starter credit applied to usage for the first 60 days from the start date
- 20% discount on first-year invoiced amounts (applies after credits exhausted)
- Milestone: if usage < $3k in first 60 days, automatic review and potential rollback of discount

Attachments: Concordia_MLA_v3_redlines.pdf (legal excerpts) + usage snapshot (sent by customer).

Requested: thumbs up / formally approved by EOD today so I can send final offer and DocuSign link to Concordia on Monday (11/16).

Thanks,
Soojin
